translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Hawthorne’s grave irony and the unresolved question whether the night was dream or fact are kept with no explanatory addition.
decisions.rationale: The story’s power is its refusal to decide.

decisions.decision: The pun on Faith as a name and as a virtue is not translated into the text; the name stays ‘Faith’.
decisions.rationale: A gloss would add words the English does not contain.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: The Faith/faith pun was dropped at the first attempt; later attempts added glosses, so the final text keeps the name ‘Faith’ and records the pun as an open note.
A repeated clause and an added epithet were removed.
A trailing clause ‘hold on to faith’ that the English lacks was cut.
An added gloss on ‘Faith below’ was removed.
Magi and wizard were distinguished; constable, ‘Christian’ and communion terms were corrected.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The wife’s name is kept as ‘Faith’ without a gloss; the pun between her name and the word faith cannot be carried without adding words, so it is recorded here rather than patched into the text.
Puritan honorifics in a Vietnamese register.
One term for the sacrament and the witch-meeting’s ironic echo of it.
The devil in the shape of Brown’s grandfather is never named directly.

witness_decision: Selected the story ‘Young Goodman Brown’ from Project Gutenberg #512, a transcription of Hawthorne’s collection Mosses from an Old Manse (1846). The story was first published anonymously in The New-England Magazine in April 1835; the Gutenberg text follows the 1846 collection and was not collated with the magazine printing.

unresolved_questions.explanation: The pun between the name Faith and the virtue is not audible in Vietnamese.

title_review.rationale: The Vietnamese title is this edition’s own rendering of ‘Young Goodman Brown’; the Puritan honorific Goodman is kept. No earlier Vietnamese title was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The farewell at the threshold with Faith.
The close: ‘a stern, a sad, a darkly meditative, a distrustful, if not a desperate man’.
